g.text: 214 NOAA Coral Reef Watch regions, 1986–2024, each counted once whatever its reef area. Degree heating weeks measure accumulated heat stress, not coral death.
In 1986 it was 5 of 214. One row is one region, one column one year.
The years 1998, 2010, 2016 and 2024 each followed an El Niño.
In 2024, four in five reef regions crossed the severe heat line
